opening: My face and neck are very swollen.
There's blood in the whites of both my eyes.
I passed out once, during a coughing attack.
At first I was told I probably had allergic asthma.
I was treated with inhalers to open my airways, steroid tablets and antihistamines, and none of it helped.
I spent 14 days in a local hospital before I was sent here.

opening.text: I've been short of breath and coughing for six weeks, and my face and neck are very swollen. There's blood in the whites of both my eyes, and I passed out once during a coughing attack. At first I was told I probably had allergic asthma, so I was treated with inhalers to open my airways, steroid tablets and antihistamines, and none of it helped. I spent 14 days in a local hospital before I was sent here.
